context_addition: HostCallContext.edit_grants:Vec<HostEditGrant>; no Serialize/Deserialize/JsonSchema/TS derives and no ApiRequest members

private_fields.HostFieldGrant: pointer(RFC6901 leaf),element_id(nullable stable declared array entry ID)

authority: UI issues/revises grants from the existing authorized task/object/field choices; Host fetches current per-session record under short Commands transaction, never trusts client JSON or old cloned context
scope: real session owns Workspace; EditScope stable Project/draft identity. Existing base_revision independently controls concurrency; Host updates definition scope revision after commit without increasing permissions
algorithm: 1. Parse the existing typed Request; reject extra caller/grant/unknown fields. Authenticate actual transport and resolve current Host scope/operation/file capability.
2. Verify expected base_revision under serialized Commands; origin-only commands and workspace departure obey existing UI/task/dirty rules.
3. Read only granted source definitions/staged task/history; expand all 15 branches into a complete candidate using current Host objects. No IO/Engine/real approval side effect yet.

4. Compute changes by typed stable identity. Arrays match declared entry IDs, never index/name alone; record changed RFC6901 leaf and pinned containing entry. Whole-object replace includes removed fields.

5. Check branch + target scope, existing target leaf/remove permission, distinct fresh create IDs/count and exact selected versions, all resource reuse references. A reusable ID does not grant editing its capacity/calendar/qualifications.

6. All create-source baseline/defaults come from actual selected module/template; transferred overrides, seed supplies/orders and imported objects still undergo authorization. Missing geometry/parameters remain named input gaps.
7. Validate complete candidate references/type/unit/range and original business rules; no partial success or error conversion to success.

8. Commit candidate, one revision/history update and current grant creation ledger together. Failure commits neither. Delete/Undo never refund; authorized Redo of the same tracked ID rechecks current grant.
new_object_rule: max_new_objects is across one grant lifetime and all branches/batches, not per call. Fields in approved creation baseline explicitly covered by allowance; reused existing fields use object grants. Derived copy does not authorize new workers/supply/BOM/duration/quality changes.
parameter_rule: instance configuration override vs draft definition default follow existing declared binding; time/BOM/quality/personnel/cost require explicit field grant, not a scheduling synonym
normalization_proof_limit: finite cases are explicit Host-private effect projections, not wire requests or proof of the future Host compiler. No normalized effects/grant are accepted from clients.
error_precedence: typed input InvalidInput/UnsupportedSchema first, real connection/scope PermissionDenied/NoActiveProject, stale known scope RevisionConflict, then whole candidate authorization PermissionDenied; references/business retain existing error families. No unauthorized object disclosure.
